Brand: FlowDesk

FlowDesk is a project management SaaS for small teams. It competes with Notion, Monday.com, and Asana. Pricing: £12–£18 per user per month. Target customer: startup operators and product managers at companies of 5–50 people.

Campaign: Q4 lead generation. Drive free trial signups and demonstrate that FlowDesk is simpler than competitors.

Objectives: Increase free trial starts by 30% vs Q3, grow MQL volume, support sales team pipeline.

Budget: £40,000 total including paid media and production.

Timeline: Launch October. Run through end of November.

Channels: LinkedIn (primary B2B), Google Search (branded and competitor terms), email nurture (existing leads), in-product referral program.

Audience: Product managers and startup operators aged 25–40 at UK/US companies of 5–50 employees. Pain points: too many tools, context switching, missed deadlines, unclear ownership.

Constraints: Cannot use competitor names directly in advertising. No guaranteed ROI claims.

Open questions: Whether to include a price comparison landing page, partnership with a productivity influencer or newsletter.
